human_take2._cloud_app_note: A commercial cloud dictation app. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: its custom dictionary had already been configured with terms including AWS, so this is NOT a like-for-like engine comparison -- it is the product AS CONFIGURED BY A USER, which is arguably the fairer test of the product but not of the model.
